09-30.solution: Let the cost be \(C\) and the price \(S\). Doubling the price makes the profit five times: \(2S - C = 5(S - C)\), so \(3S = 4C\) and \(S = \frac{4}{3}C\), a profit of \(33.33\%\).

09-42.solution: Cost \(= 25 \times 32 + 35 \times 28 = 800 + 980 = 1780\) for 60 kg. For 20% profit the 60 kg must sell for \(2136\), so \(\frac{2136}{60} = 35.60\) rupees a kg.
